description: This file contains implementation of the 'Slap Loam Server' object functions for handling IMCP-based SLAP calls, including call dispatching, buffer management, and event notification within the Service Logic Aggregation Plane architecture. It primarily defines functions for dispatching calls based on their type, freeing output buffers, and handling events, as well as associated comments and license information.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS SlapLsoCpcCallDispatch(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hLpcPartyAddr,void * pInputBuffer,ULONG ulInputSize,void ** ppOutputBuffer,PULONG pulOutputSize,PULONG pulErrorCode)
methods.description: Dispatches incoming IMCP SLAP calls to appropriate processing functions based on call type, performing size validation and error handling.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS SlapLsoCpcFreeOutputBuffer(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,void * pOutputBuffer)
methods.description: Frees memory allocated for the output buffer of a call, adjusting for buffer overhead.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS SlapLsoCpcNotifyEvent(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ULONG ulEvent,ANSC_HANDLE hReserved)
methods.description: Handles notification of LPC events; currently a stub that returns success.

ctags.name: SlapLsoCpcCallDispatch
ctags.signature: (ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hLpcPartyAddr,void * pInputBuffer,ULONG ulInputSize,void ** ppOutputBuffer,PULONG pulOutputSize,PULONG pulErrorCode)
